user.title: Select a Fumis AIR or Tulikivi Senso controller
user.description: Choose a nearby connectable controller advertising Fumis AIR, Senso, or AirMaster and the shared service. Unnamed controllers with the service are listed by address and require model selection.

model.title: Select controller model
model.description: AirMaster is shared by both products, and unnamed controllers cannot be identified from their advertisement. Select the model shown on your controller or its app.

confirm.title: Confirm controller
confirm.description: If Bluetooth pairing is required, enter the PIN from your controller manual. Leave it blank if the controller is already paired or does not request a PIN.

error.invalid_pin: Enter the six-digit Bluetooth pairing PIN, including any leading zeroes.
error.device_not_found: That controller is no longer available. Start setup again when it is in range.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check that the controller is in range, the adapter is available, and any required OS pairing is complete.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth pairing failed. Check the PIN and try again, or pair the controller through the host operating system.
error.pairing_unsupported: This adapter cannot enter a PIN through Home Assistant. Pair the controller through the host operating system, then submit setup without a PIN.
error.not_supported: The device does not expose a supported Fumis AIR or Tulikivi Senso register profile.

abort.no_devices_found: No nearby connectable Fumis AIR, Senso, AirMaster, or unnamed controllers with the required service were found.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the discovered controller.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device did not respond as a supported controller.
